dispute_ticket.description: I want the fare of S$24.60 refunded. The whole ride the driver kept telling me how good I looked tonight, how nice my legs were in this skirt, and asking if I was single. I said I'd rather just sit quietly and he carried on until we reached Changi Business Park. I did not enjoy that ride at all.

chat_logs.content: Good evening, I'm in the grey Vezel at the bus stop.

app_events.details: Rider tapped 'Confirm' on the S$24.60 quote.
Trip completed. Charged S$24.60 (equal to confirmed quote).

fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

rider_compensation.text: States how compensation to the rider is decided for a complaint about the driver's behaviour.

expected_outcome.reason: The charge is correct on the numbers: the confirmed quote at 18:04:30 was S$24.60 and the trip_completed event at 19:02:00 charged S$24.60, so there is no fare error. But the rider's description says that for the whole 28-minute ride the driver kept commenting on her appearance and kept asking whether she was single after she asked for quiet. That is unwanted personal and romantic attention from the driver, so Policy v2.1 s5.2 applies: the case is prepared by AI but must be decided by a person. No automated verdict or refund.
